definition.en: The set of measures, relationships and forms of assistance that enables individuals to understand information, consider options, communicate preferences, and make decisions according to their own will and preferences. Decision-making support respects personal autonomy and recognises that all individuals have the right to direct their own lives.

en: It may include support from trusted persons or support networks, assistance with communication, accessible information, interpretation, facilitation or advance planning. The CRPD (art. 12), as developed by General Comment No. 1 (2014), requires replacing substitute decision-making with a support model guided by the person's will and preferences, proportionate to their circumstances and accompanied by safeguards against abuse, conflict of interest and undue influence.
